GD Connect 0.12.3
• Universal macOS 14+ builds of GD Connect, GD Engine, Detect 0.2.0 and Import 0.2.0 for Apple Silicon and Intel. • Shared local file-analysis engine: Detect and Import reuse verified analysis results, recover after an engine restart and retain local fallback. • Automatic plugin updates are enabled by default. Existing user-installed formats update after the DAW closes; this can be disabled in Settings. • Download pause, recovery, parallel transfers, progress and manual install/remove remain available. • Application updates wait for open alerts or product sheets, then resume automatically after dismissal. • Existing plugin identities and saved projects are preserved. Import continues sharing library keys with current Pitch and Tune releases.
Development beta with the existing private signing identity. Apple Developer ID notarization is not included.
